notes: A small brick outbuilding on the street corner of a warehouse lot in an industrial back street: two 6 m carriageways with 15 cm kerbs on the same 3 m grid as the facades and fence panels, 3 m footpaths, sodium posts every 12 m and a power-pole line along the far side, meeting at a T in the foreground (the side street comes down from the north and ends at the front street). The den's open sides look over a bare 2.25 m apron onto the footpaths; within 10 m of them there is nothing taller than the bench, the bin, the weeds and one cone; every post, pole, sign and building over 1.5 m stands across a road (12 m or more away) or north of the back wall, where it sits beside or above the room on screen, never across it. The lot behind: the warehouse across the back, cut to end on the boundary at x 10.5 (its east wall and the wing's south face gain facade tiles because they now front streets), the lorry lane behind the den running from the side-street gate (6 m, leaves folded into the lane) past the door cluster to the lit bay and a box lorry reversed against the wall east of it, and the fenced compound on the window side (x -17..-9, wing to warehouse) with its own roller door, the two containers along the fence, the skip, the drums, the tank, the flatbed, two sodium posts, the eave flood and a 5 m gate onto the front street over a flat crossover. Across the front street an empty lot with weeds, a fly-tipped bin, two jersey barriers and a billboard facing the T, plus a bus stop on the far footpath; across the side street a single-storey metal unit with a roller door, a bin and a roof AC; further out two wide blocks and two tower silhouettes. Night: six sodium pools (front street x -3 and 9, side street z 6, the lot light by the gate, the two compound posts), the cold LEDs at the windows and the warm one at the door, the bay glow, three floods and the blinking beacon; by day the only colour is the two tags and the three cones. Conversions needed (all CC0 kits already on disk): road-asphalt-side / -center / -corner-outer at scale 3, electricity-pole-wide at 10 (elec_pole_wide), detail-bench at 3 (bench), trashcan_kenney at 2 (bin_street), road-sign-empty / -street / -stop at 8 (sign_blank / sign_street / sign_stop), ad-board at 1 (billboard), tree-shrub at 1.5-2 (weeds), truck-flat at 3 (truck_flat, optional). Removed: the warehouse tiles at x 12 and 15 and the roof/parapet beyond x 10.5, the old fences at x -12.5 and z -13 with their gate, the lane scaffold, the white bay stripes, the drums/bags/cone/puddle/yard_asphalt that sat inside the 2 m apron, the lamp post at (11.5,-10.8), building_low at (24,-32) (it is a 20 m tower, replaced by building_wide further up the street); the 44x34 slab shrinks to the lot.
